text: In the specific cause of the usage of "remote" and "near," regarding remoteness and nearness, the four elements starting with earth are not considered. These are of two kinds: those caused by space and those caused by time. Remoteness caused by space is that of the one situated far away. Nearness caused by space is that of the one situated nearby. Remoteness caused by time is that of the elder. Nearness caused by time is that of the younger.
